verdict.rationale: Ashby Assistant provides a chat-based, natural-language interface within the product (and via Slack) to ask questions, analyze pipelines, update candidates, and draft emails, which directly matches the story; the MCP server also extends natural-language control to external AI clients. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Assistant's reliability and breadth of supported commands, and no evidence of voice or broader command coverage beyond the showcased examples.
